title: per-candidate contribution trace serving model audit and M4 Chinese battle reports; score conservation, selected-vs-alternative delta decomposition, tactical concepts, PLAYER/REVIEW/DEVELOPER layers, decision-time facts only.

authority.claimDetail: 本合同冻结解释轨迹的字段、守恒、分组与中文战报规则；运行时轨迹生成器与 M4 中文渲染尚未实现。

scoreDecompositionV1.rawValue: feature value when status=KNOWN, else omitted
scoreDecompositionV1.meanScale: from the pinned artifact normalization (training mean/scale); absent when the artifact is CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED
scoreDecompositionV1.normalized: (rawValue - mean) / scale for KNOWN unmasked, else omitted
scoreDecompositionV1.weight: artifact coefficient for the featureCode; masked features have no weight applied
scoreDecompositionV1.contribution: weight * normalized for KNOWN unmasked; omitted for UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/ALWAYS_UNKNOWN; 0 only when a KNOWN unmasked contribution is exactly 0
scoreDecompositionV1.missingMask: every model feature whose status is not KNOWN (incl SETTLEMENT_DAMAGE/ROLL_REALIZATION which are ALWAYS_UNKNOWN); HARD_EXCLUSION/HARD_EXCLUSION_REASON are NOT part of the model missingMask - they are explained via hardExclusions only; masked features contribute nothing and are never explained as real 0
scoreDecompositionV1.score: intercept + sum over KNOWN unmasked contributions
scoreDecompositionV1.summationOrder: featureOrdering ascending: candidate scope first, then EFFECT_ROW by (sourceEffectId, key, featureCode) UTF-16; fixed order required for reproducibility
scoreDecompositionV1.conservation: |score - (intercept + sum contributions)| <= 1e-12; violation is FAIL_CLOSED CONSERVATION_FAILED

selectionDeltaV1.primaryAlternative: decision audit explicitAlternatives[0] when present, else highest-score eligible non-selected candidate; never an excluded candidate; when no eligible alternative exists the selection uses ALTERNATIVE_NOT_AVAILABLE with reason NO_ELIGIBLE_ALTERNATIVE and carries no scoreDelta
selectionDeltaV1.featureUnion: delta decomposition covers the union of the selected and alternative feature sets; a feature present on only one side has the other side contribution treated as 0 (its model contribution is missing-masked), and the delta row keeps statusOfSelected/statusOfAlternative plus zeroByMask=true; rows are never omitted
selectionDeltaV1.deltaPerFeature: delta = contrib_selected - contrib_alternative over the union, where a side not KNOWN-unmasked contributes 0 by mask; KNOWN-unmasked sides use their real contribution
selectionDeltaV1.scoreDelta: score_selected - score_alternative; equals the sum of all union delta rows within 1e-12 (zeroByMask rows included as 0-side deltas)
selectionDeltaV1.topPositive: deltas > 0 sorted by |delta| descending, tie-break featureCode UTF-16 ascending
selectionDeltaV1.topNegative: deltas < 0 sorted by |delta| descending, tie-break featureCode UTF-16 ascending
selectionDeltaV1.noOmission: every union delta row exists in the DEVELOPER layer; top lists are summary views only
selectionDeltaV1.alternativeNotAvailable: a selection without a real alternative (e.g. all others hard-excluded) must use the NOT_AVAILABLE branch; a scoreDelta that cannot be conserved is forbidden

topContributionsV1.perCandidateOrder: sorted by |contribution| descending, tie-break featureCode UTF-16 ascending
topContributionsV1.stability: same input yields the same order; no wall clock, no random
topContributionsV1.noOmission: all KNOWN unmasked contributions retained in DEVELOPER rows

tacticalConceptV1.rule: tacticalConcept comes from featureCode (plus key override for ATTRIBUTE_DELTA) only; never from action/actor/skill/prototype name; 角色/技能名分组禁止

playerV1.eachSentenceBound: every sentence binds at least one traceRef; traceRef grammar: featureId (selected contribution row), HARD_EXCLUSION:<code>, or DELTA:<featureId> (union delta row); an unbound or dangling ref is FAIL_CLOSED CAUSAL_CHAIN_BROKEN
playerV1.forbiddenTokenRule: PLAYER text must not contain any forbidden token; a hit is FAIL_CLOSED FORBIDDEN_TOKEN (整体拒绝，不降级)
playerV1.numbers: only decision-time public numbers with an explicit unit from REVIEW operands; spoken mapping is exact: RATIO_0_1/PROBABILITY_0_1 at 0.05 granularity (一成/一成半/两成/两成半/三成/三成半/四成/五成/六成/七成/八成/九成/满), PERCENT modifier as 成/成半 (25% => 两成半, 35% => 三成半), POWER as N倍 (integer or one decimal), COUNT as N段/N次/N点, TURNS as N回合, ABS as N点, BOOL as 有无, same-family ratios as 两倍/一半 only when the ratio is a declared public division; a number without unit/source or not derivable from trace/review is FAIL_CLOSED NUMBER_WITHOUT_UNIT; never write numbers the contributions cannot prove
playerV1.unknown: UNKNOWN/ALWAYS_UNKNOWN axes may only be expressed as 不确定/证据不足/看不出/拿不准/只能赌; never as 0 and never as a magnitude; UNKNOWN_AS_ZERO is FAIL_CLOSED
playerV1.noResultBackward: realizedOutcome never enters reason generation; any result-derived phrase is FAIL_CLOSED RESULT_BACKWARD_RATIONALIZATION
playerV1.noHidden: hidden axes (hidden HP/resistance/intent/roll) cannot appear; FAIL_CLOSED HIDDEN_INPUT
playerV1.exclusionBinding: every mention of a hard-excluded candidate binds the exclusion code; excluded candidates are never explained via score contributions
playerV1.connectiveRules: support and risk coexisting require a 转折 connective; differentiation names the primary alternative action; conclusion only at the tail
playerV1.skeletonRule: full PLAYER text follows 当时目标/局势 -> 关键公开事实 -> 支持选择的因果 -> 相对主要替代差异 -> 风险/代价; steps may merge (FACTS may merge into SUPPORT) and a step may be omitted only when no bound fact exists for it, but the relative order of present steps is fixed and CONCLUSION appears only at the tail; a step appearing out of order is FAIL_CLOSED ORDER_VIOLATION

reviewV1.operand: rawValue/mean/scale/normalized with unitFamily and value unit
reviewV1.source: sourceFactIds/sourceEventIds plus the public snapshot path for candidate-scope rows
reviewV1.rule: normalization formula and weight identity (featureCode) are REVIEW-level, never PLAYER-level

developerV1.keeps: complete contribution rows, deltas, exclusions, missingMask, conservationError, summationOrder, tieBreak evidence

realizedOutcomeV1.rule: stored separately from reason inputs; writing it back into PLAYER/REVIEW text is FAIL_CLOSED RESULT_BACKWARD_RATIONALIZATION

failClosedV1.behavior: generator refuses to emit the offending sentence/document; no degraded fallback that invents facts
failClosedV1.probeShape: independent fragment probe, never a full Trace: {caseId, kind=FAIL_CLOSED_PROBE, validationPhase=FRAGMENT, probe:{target, fragment}, expect:{schemaPhase=PASS, semanticCheck=<code>}}; fragment keys are a subset of the trace document fields
failClosedV1.validationPhase: TRACE_DOCUMENT or FRAGMENT: a full trace document validates against DecisionContributionTraceV1.schema.json first (shape only) then runs the semantic checks; a fragment probe validates against the fragmentProbe schema first and then triggers only the named semanticCheck
failClosedV1.noImpersonation: a fragment is never validated as, or reported as, a complete Trace; a probe whose fragment carries every top-level required field is MISUSED_PROBE and belongs in the gold corpus

complexity.note: C=candidates; F=feature rows per candidate (bounded by BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 caps). Decomposition is one pass per candidate; deltas one pass per alternative; no branch combination, no future traversal.

selfConsistency: tacticalConceptV1.mapping covers every featureCode in BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1.json featureCatalog and every concept is in concepts.
scoreDecompositionV1 conservation tolerance is 1e-12; summation order is the frozen featureOrdering; missingMask excludes HARD_EXCLUSION/HARD_EXCLUSION_REASON (hardExclusions owns them).

selectionDeltaV1 covers the selected/alternative feature union; either side not KNOWN-unmasked => zeroByMask=true with sideStatus kept; rows never omitted; sum of union deltas equals scoreDelta within 1e-12; ALTERNATIVE_NOT_AVAILABLE carries no scoreDelta.
selectionDeltaV1.topPositive/topNegative use |delta| descending with featureCode UTF-16 ascending tie-break.
playerV1.forbiddenTokens contains weight/score/featureCode/HEPP/Pareto/internal ids; no token is a substring of a legal Chinese sentence.

validationOrderV1 runs schema shape first, then semantic checks incl conservation recompute; failClosed fragment probes validate against #/$defs/fragmentProbe first and then trigger only the named semanticCheck (MISUSED_PROBE when a fragment impersonates a full Trace).
every failClosedV1 code has a machine-checkable trigger in this contract and a fragment probe case (DecisionContributionTraceCasesV1.json probes) naming target + semanticCheck.
realizedOutcomeV1 is independent; no reason input may read it.
schema closes every object with additionalProperties false; trace documents validate against DecisionContributionTraceV1.schema.json.

validationOrderV1.traceDocument: a full trace document must validate against DecisionContributionTraceV1.schema.json first (shape only; conservationError is a record, not an arithmetic proof); semantic checks run only after schema passes
validationOrderV1.fragmentProbe: a failClosed fragment probe must validate its container and fragment against #/$defs/fragmentProbe first (shape only), then trigger the named semanticCheck; fragments are never validated against the top-level required set and never reported as complete traces
semanticChecks: conservation: recompute |score - (intercept + sum KNOWN-unmasked contributions)| and |scoreDelta - sum union deltas|; either beyond 1e-12 is CONSERVATION_FAILED even when the document is schema-valid
traceRefs bind real selected contribution featureIds, HARD_EXCLUSION:<code> entries, or DELTA:<featureId> union delta rows
numbers carry a unit from REVIEW operands
skeleton order respected; CONCLUSION only at tail
UNKNOWN spoken only as 不确定/证据不足/看不出/拿不准/只能赌

hardExclusions.purpose: hard exclusions live here, not in the model missingMask
hardExclusions.versionNote: revision 1 chapter name hardExclusionTraceV1; canonical field name is hardExclusions, matching the trace document field and schema property; no second field is retained
hardExclusions.rule: each excluded candidate (or forced-target constraint) carries code + reasonText; excluded candidates are never explained via score contributions; HARD_EXCLUSION/HARD_EXCLUSION_REASON feature rows in a feature vector are legality metadata, not model features, and never enter missingMask or the score sum
hardExclusions.schema: hardExclusions array in the trace document, each {code, reasonText}
